title: Instantiate the periodic-density formula to compute the E8 packing density
intent: Assemble the E8 packing density π^4/384 from the general periodic-density formula PeriodicSpherePacking.density_eq, instantiated at d=8, lattice E8Lattice, basis E8_ℤBasis and bound L=16, by substituting the three E8-specific ingredients (numReps=1, covolume=1, and the per-basis-vector norm bound 2).
also_known_as: instantiate a formula over a structure at one member

parent.name: E8Packing_density
parent.statement: theorem E8Packing_density : E8Packing.density = ENNReal.ofReal π ^ 4 / 384 := by

children.name: PeriodicSpherePacking.density_eq
children.statement:
theorem PeriodicSpherePacking.density_eq
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ fundamentalDomain (b.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ _), ‖x‖ ≤ L) (hd : 0 < d) :
    S.density
      = S.numReps * volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (S.separation / 2))
        / volume (fundamentalDomain (b.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ _)) :=

children.name: E8_ℤBasis_apply_norm
children.statement: lemma E8_ℤBasis_apply_norm : ∀ i : Fin 8, ‖E8_ℤBasis i‖ ≤ 2 := by
children.closed_by: intro i; simpa [coe_E8_ℤBasis_apply, E8Basis_apply] using E8Basis_apply_norm i

children.name: E8_ℤBasis_ofZLatticeBasis_volume
children.statement:
lemma E8_ℤBasis_ofZLatticeBasis_volume :
    volume (fundamentalDomain (E8_ℤBasis.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ E8Lattice)) = 1 := by

applicability.goal_shape: A goal P(c) = v for a concrete object c of some structure class, where a general formula ∀ S d, P(S) = f(S.numReps, covolume(S), separation(S), d) has already been proved over the whole class; the instance is produced by `rw [general_formula c args]` and then substituting a small number of concrete ingredient values (each a named lemma).
applicability.use_when: the general statement already exists and its parameters (dimension d, basis b, bound L) can be supplied syntactically; the concrete ingredient values (numReps, covolume, norm bound) each have short proofs; the goal matches the general formula's left-hand side up to unfolding.
applicability.avoid_when: the general statement has to be proved as part of the job (then the general proof, not the instantiation, is the content); the ingredient values are many or deep (the 'instantiation' then hides the real work); each value needs a different argument rather than a uniform substitution, or the bound L has to be chosen by search.

consequences: Instantiating the general formula creates two obligations: (i) the side conditions of density_eq — hL (a norm bound over the fundamental domain, discharged here by E8_ℤBasis_apply_norm and the choice L=16) and hd (0<d, closed by omega) — become subgoals of the rewrite, and (ii) each concrete ingredient (numReps, covolume, norm bound) must be a separate named, proved lemma. Failure modes: choosing L too small makes the hL goal unprovable by the available norm lemmas; the rw only fires if the goal's head matches the general formula's left-hand side syntactically; and the move hides a potentially large dependency cone (depth ≥ 5 here) inside a deceptively short glue.
